description: Kinect-derived 14-segment approximation; trunk includes pelvis. Not a validated anatomical or clinical model.
local_axes: Non-foot: z longitudinal/proximally directed, x projected subject-right, y=z cross x. Foot: y ankle-to-foot-index, x projected subject-right, z=x cross y.
parameter_policy: Mass fractions and CoM fractions are copied from the user's Kinect 14-segment implementation, not relabeled as an unmodified de Leva table. Restore the longitudinal gyration coefficients present but commented out in Segments_Moment.m to form full 3-D tensors. No legacy scalar trace-plus-distance sum is used.
length_policy: Pooled bilateral median over the explicit calibration window; fixed within a trial. Kinect default inertia lengths are Hand=0.08 m and Foot=0.15 m; landmark_median mode or explicit per-type lengths may override them. CoM uses framewise endpoint interpolation, not a length-constrained skeleton.

landmark_proxies.head_center: mean(left_ear,right_ear); substitute for Kinect HEAD, not measured anatomical head CoM
landmark_proxies.neck: mean(left_shoulder,right_shoulder); shoulder-center proxy, not a detected neck joint
landmark_proxies.hand_endpoint: mean(same-side index,pinky); substitute for Kinect HAND, not anatomically identical
landmark_proxies.foot_endpoint: same-side foot_index; substitute for Kinect FOOT, not a heel-to-toe segment
landmark_proxies.pelvis: mean(left_hip,right_hip); no separate mass because pelvis is included in Trunk
